title: Upgrade Leave Application Generator to Semi-Smart Guided Application with Calendar, Dropdowns, and Live Preview

requirements.summary: Replace manual date input with calendar date picker supporting single date and date range selection with automatic formatting
acceptanceCriteria: Date picker allows selecting a single date for one-day leave
Date picker allows selecting a date range for multiple-day leave
Selected dates are automatically formatted into a proper leave duration in the generated letter

file_operations.description: Create a Calendar component using shadcn/ui that supports both single date and date range selection modes. The component should accept props for selection mode (single or range), selected date(s), and onChange handler. Style it consistently with the existing StudentSathi design system using Tailwind CSS and the OKLCH color scheme from index.css.
Create a Popover component using shadcn/ui to wrap the Calendar component. This provides the dropdown behavior for the date picker with trigger button and popover content positioning.

Create utility functions to format selected dates into proper leave duration strings. Include functions to: (1) format a single date as 'on [date]', (2) format a date range as 'from [start date] to [end date]', and (3) calculate the number of days in a range. Use clear, professional formatting suitable for formal leave applications.

Replace the existing manual Leave Date/Period text input field with the new Calendar component wrapped in a Popover. Add state management for single date vs date range selection mode toggle. Wire the calendar selection to update the leave duration text using the formatting utilities. Ensure the selected dates are reflected in the live preview (REQ-4 implementation).

requirements.summary: Add Reason for Leave dropdown with predefined options and auto-generated professional sentences, plus custom input for Other option
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown includes all five specified options: Sick Leave, Family Function, Personal Work, Emergency, Other
Each predefined reason generates an appropriate professional sentence in the letter
Selecting 'Other' reveals a custom text input field
Custom reason text is inserted into the generated letter when provided

file_operations.description: Create a Select dropdown component using shadcn/ui with SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem primitives. Style consistently with StudentSathi design system using Tailwind CSS and OKLCH colors.

Create a utility module defining the five predefined leave reasons (Sick Leave, Family Function, Personal Work, Emergency, Other) and a function that maps each reason to its corresponding professional sentence template for insertion into the leave letter. For example, Sick Leave might generate 'I am writing to request leave due to illness', Family Function might generate 'I need to attend an important family function', etc.

Replace the existing manual Reason text input with the new Select component containing the five predefined options. Add conditional rendering to show a custom text input field when 'Other' is selected. Wire the dropdown selection to automatically generate the appropriate professional sentence using the reasons utility. Integrate the generated reason text into the live preview (REQ-4 implementation). Ensure the custom reason field updates the preview in real-time when 'Other' is selected.

requirements.summary: Add required School/College Name and Class/Grade input fields with automatic insertion into generated letter
acceptanceCriteria: School/College Name field is present and marked as required
Class/Grade field is present and marked as required
Both fields are inserted into the appropriate positions in the generated letter

file_operations.description: Create a reusable Input component using shadcn/ui with consistent styling matching the StudentSathi design system. Support required attribute, placeholder text, and onChange handlers.

Add two new required input fields using the Input component: School/College Name and Class/Grade. Position these fields logically in the form layout (e.g., after the Name field and before Date selection). Add state management for both new fields. Wire these fields to insert their values into the appropriate positions in the generated leave letter format. Update the live preview (REQ-4 implementation) to reflect these fields in real-time. Apply HTML5 required validation to both fields.

requirements.summary: Implement real-time Live Preview Panel on the right side showing generated leave application letter
acceptanceCriteria: Preview panel is positioned on the right side of the form
Letter preview updates instantly whenever any form field changes
No Generate button is required to update the preview
All form fields (Name, Date, Reason, School, Class) are reflected in the live preview

file_operations.description: Create a utility function that generates the complete leave application letter text from input parameters (name, school, class, date/duration, reason text). Return a properly formatted multi-line string with appropriate salutation, body paragraphs, closing, and signature sections following formal letter conventions for student leave applications.

Restructure the page layout to use a two-column responsive grid: left column for the form inputs, right column for the Live Preview Panel. Create a preview section component/area that displays the generated letter using the letter template utility. Wire all form field state changes (name, school, class, date, reason) to trigger automatic regeneration of the letter preview using React hooks (useEffect or useMemo). Remove any existing Generate button. Ensure the preview updates instantly on every keystroke or selection change. Style the preview area to look like a letter document with appropriate padding, typography, and background.

requirements.summary: Add Copy to Clipboard and Download as PDF action buttons below the letter preview
acceptanceCriteria: Copy to Clipboard button successfully copies the full letter text
Download as PDF button generates and downloads a PDF file
Both buttons are positioned below the letter preview
PDF is formatted appropriately for printing

file_operations.description: Create a utility function to generate a PDF from the leave application letter text. Use browser print-to-PDF functionality by creating a formatted HTML document with proper letter styling (margins, font, spacing) and opening it in a new window with window.print(). Ensure the PDF output is properly formatted for printing with standard letter dimensions and professional appearance.

Add two action buttons below the Live Preview Panel: 'Copy to Clipboard' and 'Download as PDF'. Wire the Copy button to use the Clipboard API (navigator.clipboard.writeText) to copy the full generated letter text. Wire the Download button to call the PDF export utility function. Add user feedback for both actions (e.g., toast notifications or temporary success messages). Style both buttons consistently with the existing Button component (frontend/src/components/primitives/Button.tsx) and position them horizontally below the preview area with appropriate spacing.

requirements.summary: Ensure mobile-responsive design with adaptive layout for form and preview panel
acceptanceCriteria: Layout is fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens
Form and preview panel adapt appropriately for different screen sizes
UI remains clean and easy to use for students
No unnecessary complexity is added to the interface

file_operations.description: Implement responsive grid breakpoints for the two-column layout: on mobile (sm and below), stack the form and preview vertically (form first, preview below); on tablet and desktop (md and above), display them side-by-side with appropriate column widths. Use Tailwind responsive utilities (sm:, md:, lg:) to control layout behavior. Ensure all form inputs, calendar popover, dropdown, and buttons remain fully functional and properly sized on small screens. Test that the preview panel is scrollable on mobile when letter content is long. Maintain the clean, student-friendly aesthetic across all screen sizes.
